description.fallback: An online shop, front and back. Shoppers browse by size and colour, see what is in stock, pay on a secure page and follow their order; the desk packs, ships and takes returns — every price, tax, number and stock figure decided by your own database.

help.fallback: The days the shop packs and ships, as a comma list: mon,tue,wed,thu,fri,sat,sun.

Answer shoppers in a chat window on the shop.
Make landing pages for a season or a sale.
